proof_body:
by
  intro x y hx hy
  rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, Real.cos_add]
  have h : Real.sin x / Real.cos x * (Real.sin y / Real.cos y) = Real.sin x * Real.sin y / (Real.cos x * Real.cos y) := by
    field_simp
  rw [h, div_eq_one_iff_eq (mul_ne_zero hx hy)]
  constructor
  · intro e
    rw [e]
    ring
  · intro e
    linarith
target_source: ∀ x y : ℝ, Real.cos x ≠ 0 → Real.cos y ≠ 0 → (Real.tan x * Real.tan y = 1 ↔ Real.cos (x + y) = 0)
